import re, os
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))

def regions(inp):
    # find separator rows: rows that are single repeated nonzero color
    seps=[i for i,r in enumerate(inp) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=0]
    return seps

for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 2 input']:
    inp=G[k]; print(k, regions(inp))

def test_align(k, rev):
    inp=G[k]; out=G[k.replace('input','output')]
    seps=regions(inp); s=seps[0]
    top=inp[:s]; bot=inp[s+1:]
    n=min(len(top),len(bot))
    ok=True
    for i in range(n):
        ti=i if not rev else len(top)-1-i
        bi=i if not rev else len(bot)-1-i
        for j in range(len(top[0])):
            expect=2 if (top[ti][j]!=0 and bot[bi][j]!=0) else 0
            if out[i][j]!=expect: return False
    # also check rest of out is 0
    for i in range(n,len(out)):
        if any(out[i]): return False
    return True
for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 2 input']:
    print(k, 'fwd', test_align(k,False), 'rev', test_align(k,True))
